status: frozen before any step-5 data analysis or fitting
split: FIT blocks of step2/holdout_v7.json identify; structure choices by week-parity cross-validation inside FIT; TUNE blocks are the untouched test set (Steps 2-4 used T_return only as an input and never modelled the room)
rationale: The new controller's Delta-T-collapse rule compares T_mix_out - T_return_floor with min_useful_delta_t (a few kelvin) and the flush logic waits for T_return to stabilise; a HIL return-temperature error near 1 K would trigger or suppress these rules wrongly. Room temperature drives the slab losses and HA comfort logic; 0.5 K is the order of a thermostat hysteresis.

scoring.t_return: free-run simulation over each TUNE block with measured T_forward, floor-pump state, room and outdoor temperature as inputs; all states initialised from measurements at the block start; samples from 2 h after the block start, with fresh T_return, T_forward (age <= 900 s) and no input outage (T_boiler age <= 900 s), outside Step 3 fault days
scoring.room: same free run; room samples between 22:00 and 06:00 local time only (no solar gain), room sensor age <= 3600 s
